<!--
  One to five stars (a review's grade, the average of a product). The value is read as the label; the stars
  themselves are decoration.
-->
<script lang="ts">
export type RatingProps = {
  value: number;
  label: string;
  max?: number;
  size?: number;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { value, label, max = 5, size = 16, class: className } = defineProps<RatingProps>();
const full = computed(() => Math.round(Math.min(max, Math.max(0, value))));
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    :class="cn('inline-flex items-center gap-0', className)"
    role="img"
    :aria-label="label"
    data-slot="rating"
    :data-value="full"
  >
    <LucideIcon
      v-for="i in Array.from({ length: max }, (_, i) => i)"
      :key="i"
      name="star"
      :size="size"
      :class="((i < full) ? 'fill-foreground text-foreground' : 'text-border')"
    />
  </Block>
</template>
